---
title: "Lung cancer in Ohio, 1968--1988"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
    theme: cosmo
    source_code: embed
runtime: shiny
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(shiny)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(leaflet)
library(DT)
library(tigris)
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

# data: one row per county and year
oh <- read_csv("data/ohio_lung_cancer_1968_1988.csv",
               col_types = cols(GEOID = "c"))          # GEOID as text

# boundaries
oh_map <- counties(state = "OH", cb = TRUE, year = 2020,
                   progress_bar = FALSE) |>
  st_transform(4326)                             # leaflet wants lon/lat

# Ohio by year: reads no input, computed once
ohio_year <- oh |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(Y = sum(Y), E = sum(E), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(SIR = Y / E, area = "Ohio")
```


Column {data-width=600}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### SIR by county, selected years (black outline: selected county)

```{r map}
breaks <- c(0, 0.5, 2/3, 0.9, 1/0.9, 1.5, 2, Inf)  # Exercise 4 classes

renderLeaflet({
  d <- left_join(oh_map, by_county(), by = "GEOID")
  pal <- colorBin(rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(7, "RdBu")),
                  domain = d$SIR, bins = breaks)

  leaflet(d) |>
    addProviderTiles(
      providers$Esri.WorldImagery,
      options = providerTileOptions(opacity = 0.5)
    ) |>
    addPolygons(
      fillColor = ~pal(SIR), fillOpacity = 0.8,
      color = "white", weight = 1,
      label = ~sprintf("%s: SIR %.2f (%.0f observed, %.0f expected)",
                       NAME, SIR, Y, E),
      highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 2, color = "black",
                                          bringToFront = TRUE)
    ) |>
    addPolygons(data = filter(d, NAME == input$county),   # selected county
                fill = FALSE, color = "black", weight = 3) |>
    addLegend("bottomright", pal = pal, values = ~SIR,
              title = paste0("SIR<br>", input$years[1], "-", input$years[2]),
              labFormat = labelFormat(digits = 2), opacity = 0.8)
})
```

> SIR = observed / expected over the selected years. Red: more cases than
> expected; blue: fewer.

Column {data-width=400}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### SIR by year (grey band: selected years; dashed line: as many cases as expected)

```{r timeseries}
renderPlotly({
  one <- oh |>
    filter(county == input$county) |>
    mutate(SIR = Y / E, area = input$county)

  cols <- setNames(c("black", "#B2182B"), c("Ohio", input$county))

  p <- ggplot(bind_rows(ohio_year, one), aes(year, SIR, colour = area)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = input$years[1] - 0.5,
             xmax = input$years[2] + 0.5,
             ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "grey90") +  # selected years
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2, colour = "grey50") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 1.2) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = cols) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "SIR", colour = NULL) +
    theme_minimal()

  ggplotly(p)                                  # hover, zoom
})
```

### Counties, selected years

```{r table}
renderDT({
  by_county() |>
    transmute(County = county, Observed = Y,
              Expected = round(E, 1), SIR = round(SIR, 2)) |>
    arrange(desc(SIR)) |>
    datatable(rownames = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 10)) |>
    formatStyle("County", target = "row",
                fontWeight = styleEqual(input$county, "bold"))  # selected county
})
```

> Data: Moraga (2019), Ch. 7. Boundaries: US Census Bureau, via `tigris`.
